Toedscruel

Ground Grass

Paldea · Generation 9

Toedscruel is a Ground/Grass-type Woodear Pokémon first found in Paldea (Generation 9). It stands 1.9 m tall and weighs 58 kg. It evolves from Toedscool. Its highest base stat is Sp. Def (120), with a base stat total of 515.
